notes: Client-rendered (React) site; qty read from the rendered 'N produits' PLP header via Playwright, not from raw HTML. Site was frequently and intermittently unavailable during this extraction (recurring 503 'Site en maintenance' responses unrelated to request volume/robots.txt, which has no Claude-specific disallow), which forced repeated retries and left a number of confirmed-real leaf categories with qty unconfirmed (flagged MANUAL REVIEW below) rather than fabricated. Discovery: robots.txt sitemap -> sitemap-cat.xml (searched for 'noel'/'sapin'/'halloween'/'paques'/'valentin'/'diwali'/festival terms) plus the rendered main 'Noel' hub page (jardin-et-terrasse/noel/cat_id_0001879.cat) and its sub-hub pages. Only Christmas ('Noel') is a genuine live seasonal taxonomy branch; no Easter/Valentine/Diwali/New Year categories exist in the sitemap. A stale sitemap entry for 'decoration-dhalloween/cat_id_0005863.cat' resolves to an empty shell page (breadcrumb + footer only, no title, no product grid, no count) -- Halloween decor is not a live category on this site, so no Halloween row is emitted (status remains 'ok' since Christmas is present; this is a within-company absence, documented per seasonal rules S12/S18). 'Guirlande de Noel' is linked from three different nav labels/positions (Guirlande de Noel, Guirlande de Noel decorative, and a 'guirlandes lumineuses' banner) that all resolve to the same URL/cat_id_0002065 -- kept once per the shared overlap rule. Five nodes are genuine parents whose children are subsets (either an aggregate PLP whose count ~= sum of children, or an editorial sub-hub page with no product grid of its own) and are recorded as grouping rows (qty/link null) per core rule 0.6 and seasonal rules S9: 'Christmas Trees' (site aggregate total 906), 'Christmas Tree Decorations' (site aggregate total 1258), 'Christmas Decorations' (editorial hub, no own count), 'Light-Up Christmas Decorations' (site aggregate total 147), 'Outdoor Christmas Decorations' (editorial hub, no own count). ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): site is back online; live rechecked all previously qty-unconfirmed rows and updated exact qty for Light-Up Outdoor Christmas Tree (21), Snow Globe (6), Light-Up Christmas Wreath (2), Light-Up Snowman (4), Inflatable Christmas Decoration (687), Christmas Wrapping Paper (373), Christmas Sweater (4), Christmas Candle (39), Christmas Window Stickers (1060). Removed 'Christmas Bell' (cloche-de-noel) and 'Light-Up Santa' (pere-noel-lumineux) rows -- both confirmed live with '0 produit', genuinely empty categories currently, dropped per the shared 0-qty convention. Removed 'Christmas Storage' (rangement-noel) row -- URL still 302-redirects straight to a single PDP (a wreath storage bag), confirming it fails the PLP test rather than being a genuine category listing. Removed 'Christmas Window Decoration' (decoration-de-noel-pour-fenetre) row -- live recheck shows it resolves to the exact same 1060-product listing (identical product set/order) as 'Christmas Window Stickers' (stickers-de-noel); kept Window Stickers only per the shared overlap rule.
